messages:
maria: Heads-up — found a permission-gating bug in the canary toggle path. UI shows the canary switch enabled for users without the `canary_deployer` role. @kevin can reproduce.

kevin: Can you share quick repro? steps + logs pls.

maria: Repro steps: 1) login as non-canary user 2) open /rollouts/123 3) toggle shows enabled and submits a toggle request. Backend returns 200. Log snippet: 
```
[2025-03-12T14:25:10Z] auth.check -> user=svc-123 role_check=false
[2025-03-12T14:25:10Z] rollout.toggle -> user=svc-123 result=success canary=true
```
Seems the frontend is doing visibility gating but the backend accepts the toggle without re-checking RBAC if the request includes `x-fe-canary:true`.

jamal: Ugh. So this is an accept-if-present header issue? Could be the legacy `allow_ui_overrides` path. Any audit events for the toggle?

maria: No audit event emitted for `rollout.toggle` when triggered this way. We only log `rollout.toggle` on the canonical path; the shim path forgets audit.

kyle: Quick triage: likely two bugs — 1) backend endpoint trusts frontend flag instead of server-side authz re-check; 2) missing audit for the shim. Both are security-critical.

sre-ops: If this makes it to hosted customers, we need an emergency mitigation. Suggest blocking the shim route at the gateway with a 403 for non-admins until patched.

kevin: Agreed. Quick patch: reject requests with `x-fe-canary` unless header `x-auth-verified: true`. But that's just a band-aid. We'll add server-side RBAC check and emit audit events.

maria: Proposed backend fix (PR draft):
```
// rollout handler
if (!authz.hasRole(user, "canary_deployer")) {
  audit.log(user, "rollout.toggle", {allowed: false, reason: "missing_role"});
  return res.status(403).json({error: "forbidden"});
}
audit.log(user, "rollout.toggle", {allowed: true, target: rollout_id});
// proceed
```

jamal: Nice. Also add a unit test that simulates `x-fe-canary:true` coming from UI and assert 403.

deploy-bot: NOTE: hotfix branch created -> hotfix/canary-auth-1748904321

sre-ops: Mitigation steps for now: 
- Add rule to gateway WAF to drop `x-fe-canary` header from external requests.
- Add temporary deny for endpoint `/api/v1/rollouts/*/toggle` for non-admins at the gateway.

kevin: I'll own the code patch + tests. @jamal can you add the audit event and a quick e2e? @kyle can you help with WAF rule?

maria: I'll create a short incident note for compliance (need KMS audit correlator later).

jamal: Will do. Also checking if any customer toggles happened in last 7 days. Log query I used: `service:rollout action:toggle status:success | user.role!=canary_deployer`

kyle: WAF rule in progress, will push in 10m. ping me if we need rollback. :hammer_and_wrench:

kevin: ETA for patch + tests ~2-3 hours, then hotfix deploy.

maria: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: (1) remove legacy shim in 2.2, (2) audit-log coverage report, (3) add RBAC integration tests to CI.

sre-ops: Marking thread for incident tracking: INC-2025-078-canary-gate. Keep updates here.

maria: Also creating a small compliance note for legal: recorded events will be tied to KMS envelope ids — will follow up with @security-kms team.

kevin: Good catch. Will include a changelog entry for Dedicated/Private customers.

maria: Closing initial triage. Follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
